name: Market menu
summary: The chef writes the menu after the visit to the market or the farm, and the dishes change each day or each week with what is fresh.
how: Buy the produce on the same day, from the same traders or farms.
Write the menu after the purchase, and keep it short.
Print or write the menu by hand on the day, and name the farm or the market.

origin.note: Paul Bocuse and the chefs of nouvelle cuisine bought produce at the market and built the menu from it.

adoptions.via: Alice Waters served one set menu at Chez Panisse that changed each day with the produce of local farms.
Yves Camdeborde wrote a fixed menu on a blackboard at La Régalade and changed it with the market.
